explanation: This lemma only computes with the library's own definitions. It evaluates the library's `baseChangeNormalFormHom` (an L-algebra map built from the library's `lift` into `ThickenedLineCoordinateRing`) on the library's `nilpotentWitness` (1 ⊗ y − α ⊗ x) and gets the library's `thickenedLineW`. The proof just unfolds these definitions and runs `simp`, so all of the content comes from the library's own constructions. Mathlib has no statement about these objects. I read the three definitions in `FrobeniusTwistedLineBaseChange.lean` and `FrobeniusTwistedLine.lean`; since they are all specific to the library, no Mathlib declaration could carry this result.
